 COMMON ORDER (Order of the Court was made by S.M.SUBRAMANIAM, J.) W.P(MD)No.13762 of 2020 has been instituted to direct the respondents 1 to 3 to take appropriate action against the fourth respondent based on the petitioner's representation dated 12.08.2020.
2.W.P(MD)No.15759 of 2020 has been instituted to direct the respondents 1 and 2 to instruct the 3 to 6 respondents: A. to set up warehouses in each panchayat for the farmers to store the food grains safely at low rent in Tamilnadu; B. to increase the number of direct procurement center with all facilities in Tamilnadu; C. to provide tharpaai and sheds at a larger level in all direct procurement centers in Tamil Nadu D. to install CCTV Cameras with the latest technology in each direct procurement center in Tamil Nadu and E.
By considering the petitioner's representation dated 19.10.2020.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
3.Regarding the allegations of corrupt activities in W.P(MD)No.13762 of 2020
, a specific complaint is to be filed before the competent authority.
In the event of receiving any such complaint, the authority concerned is bound to take an action to ascertain the truth and initiate all further actions in the manner known to law.
4.The omnibus reliefs sought for in the Writ Petition in W.P(MD)No.15579 of 2020 cannot be issued by the High Court in the said Writ Petition.

5.Administrative decisions are to be taken by the Government for providing services to the farmers,
strategically in various locations.
6.The petitioner, appearing in person, submitted that the existing warehouse facilities are insufficient.
7.The learned Government Pleader submitted that warehouses are being constructed periodically on need basis by the Government.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
However, if more numbers are required, it is to be considered by the Government in the interest of the farmers and to protect agricultural produce.
